intro: Foreman Thazz'ril is an orc labor supervisor stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Tasked with keeping peons on schedule and maintaining basic infrastructure for young warriors, he is perpetually frustrated by lazy laborers and nearby cultist activity.

p: Building a new home in the harsh red rock of Durotar requires unending physical labor. In the Valley of Trials, Foreman Thazz'ril oversees the peons chopping lumber and gathering materials needed to support both the encampment and the wider Horde war effort. Unfortunately for Thazz'ril, peons are notoriously prone to slacking off and taking naps under the desert sun. To keep construction moving, he regularly enlists newly arrived recruits to give the slumbering workers a brisk wallop with his trusty blackjack, instilling obedience through blunt persuasion.

sections.t: A Lost Pick in Dangerous Hands
p: Thazz'ril's responsibilities also involve surveying the valley's mineral resources, though that duty led to an embarrassing misstep. While scouting the cave known as the Burning Blade Coven, he was forced to flee from the dark cultists lurking inside, accidentally abandoning his treasured enchanted pick. Too cautious to retrieve it himself amidst the gathering warlocks and their demonic minions, he relies on young Horde aspirants to venture into the depths and return his tool.
